passage:
A city website showed where residents had reported noise problems. The map revealed clusters near construction sites, night markets, and highways.
City officials used the data to plan inspections and adjust rules.
However, students noticed that quieter neighborhoods with older residents had fewer online reports, possibly because people there did not use the website.
The teacher said complaint data shows reported problems, not all problems.
The map was useful, but incomplete.
Data often reflects who has access, confidence, and time to report. To understand a city, officials must listen beyond the easiest data points.
